name: Zetsubou no Fuchi
source:
Sevina, the main character, is determined to stand up to the demons, even if she has to do it alone.
Until now, she has fought countless battles in her home country.
In order to complete her mission, she crosses the border to another country, and fighting in an unknown locale will prove to be...
